label: Blender
description: Control Blender for 3D modeling and export to UEFN. Installs the Blender addon automatically — open Blender after enabling.

settings.sections.title: Connection
settings.sections.description: On enable, this plugin copies the Blender MCP addon into your Blender user folders. Open (or restart) Blender — the server auto-starts on the port below. Use blender_status / blender_redeploy_addon tools if needed.

steps.title: Blender plugin enabled
steps.body: Addon files were copied into Blender. If Preferences → Add-ons still shows Blender MCP unchecked, tick it once (or restart Blender so the startup enabler flips it). Then N → BlenderMCP → Connect if needed. No uv / GitHub install.

steps.title: Talk to Blender
steps.body: With Blender open, ask the agent to inspect the scene or model. Tools appear under blender_*. For text/image-to-3D SaaS generation, install the separate 3D AI Studio Store plugin.
